objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has copied malware executables, such as [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029).exe, to the local `C:\Temp` directory.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)(Citation: CarveyODonnellWelchHuntress_TheGentlemen_May2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) had also enabled a hidden SMB share pointed at the `C:\Temp` folder to allow anonymous access.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also consolidated data in `C:\ProgramData\data\`.(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)
